name: Sweet Chili Sauce
siboNotes: Contains excess fructose from sugar and corn syrup; use sparingly as it can feed bacterial overgrowth. Stick to 1 tablespoon portions to minimize fermentation.
preparationTips: Measure portions carefully as FODMAP load increases quickly with larger servings
Look for brands without high fructose corn syrup if possible
Dilute with rice vinegar or lime juice to extend volume without adding FODMAPs
Use as a finishing sauce rather than cooking ingredient to better control portions
alternatives: Soy sauce with a pinch of sugar
Homemade version using glucose instead of regular sugar
nutritionalHighlights: Provides small amounts of vitamin C
